To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
students who were more engaged in the learning process had better performance in science than those who were less engaged.
the students in the study had a positive attitude toward science and science learning and that their attitude was positively related to their science achievement.

(a) Students’ attitude to learning science in junior school has a significant influence on their performance in science; (b) Students’ attitude toward science is influenced by their teachers and parents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the problems of teaching of learning of science in junior secondary school.
the problems of teaching basic science in junior schools.
the problems of teaching science in junior secondary school.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the problems of teaching science at junior secondary school level is not peculiar to Nigeria alone.
the teaching and learning process is not a one way process but a two-way process in which the teacher and student both contribute to the learning process.
science education in Nigeria is not only facing problems but is also facing a crisis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that is based on this study.
we have shown that the teaching and learning process of science is very important in junior secondary schools in Nigeria.
science education is a process of acquiring knowledge, skills, attitudes and values related to the natural and man-made environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to think about the problem of science education in a new way.
the quality of the teaching and learning environment in junior secondary schools in Nasara- wa state has been found to be poor.
we have a better understanding of how science teachers are teaching science in their classrooms, and what they think are some of the problems with science education today.
